Usage: main uninstall [OPTIONS]

  Remove a harness adapter configuration.

Options:
  --harness NAME         Harness adapter name or 'all' for every supported
                         harness.  [required]
  --yes                  Skip confirmation prompt.
  --project PATH         Project root for project-scope harnesses (e.g.,
                         cursor). Required by adapters that materialize into a
                         project tree rather than a user-scope configuration
                         directory.
  -q, --quiet            Suppress informational output; only errors are emitted.
  -v, --verbose          Emit additional diagnostic output.
  --format [plain|json]  Output format.  [default: plain]
  --no-color             Disable ANSI color codes in output.
  --json                 Shorthand for --format json.
  -h, --help             Show this message and exit.

  Examples:
    apothem uninstall --harness claude-code
    apothem uninstall --harness all --project . --yes
    apothem uninstall --harness claude-code --yes

  Related commands:
    install      Install a harness configuration
    uninstalling Continuous-form alias for uninstall
    verify       Check installation status

  Exit codes:
    0  Adapter uninstalled or was not installed
    1  Harness not found, confirmation declined or unavailable
       (non-interactive or JSON mode without --yes), or every removal failed
       before removing anything
    2  Partial removal or an unfinished uninstall — files were removed before
       a failure, Apothem's files stay behind a link, a file holds two
       different blocks between Apothem's markers, an earlier release's files
       differ from this release's, or the install has no record (for the last
       two, first fix each file a warning names for an Apothem marker, then
       run apothem update, then uninstall again)
    64 Usage error: unknown option or command, or a missing or invalid value
